feed.title: Recent jobs for this page
feed.sub: Up to 20 recent public jobs. You can look without an account.
feed.error: We couldn't load jobs right now.
feed.empty: No public jobs for this page right now.
feed.alertsLink: Get new jobs like these by email
feed.fitNote: Fit scores need your resume, so they show only after you sign up.

gate.title: See every job for your search, and how well each one fits you
gate.body: A free account shows every job for your search, compares each one with your resume, and keeps track of where you applied. You still apply on each company's site yourself.

assistant.title: Ask about this page
assistant.intro: Ask about the jobs on this page, pay as the posts list it, or how %BRAND% works. Answers do not use a resume and never say how well you fit a job.
assistant.note: Answers are written by AI and can be wrong. Nothing you type here is saved.

chips.remote: Which of these jobs can be done remotely?
chips.pay: What do jobs like these pay?

errors.rateLimited: That's the limit for questions without an account. Create a free account to keep asking.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is not available right now.

alerts.title: Get new jobs by email
alerts.sub: No account needed. Pick a job and a place, and we email new public jobs once a day or once a week.
alerts.unavailable: Job alerts by email are not available here.
alerts.emailHint: We send a confirmation link first. Nothing else is sent until you press it.
alerts.consent: Email me new jobs for this search. I can stop them with one click in any email.
alerts.privacy: We keep your address only to send these alerts. Sign-ups that are not confirmed are deleted after 72 hours.
alerts.sentBody: If {email} can get alerts, a confirmation link is on its way. Nothing is sent until you press it. The link works for 72 hours.
alerts.signupInstead: Want alerts that use your resume? Create a free account.

errors.consent: Tick the box to agree to these emails.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-ups from this network today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.generic: We couldn't send that. Try again.

meta.title: Job alerts by email
meta.description: Get new public jobs for one search by email, once a day or once a week. No account needed; stop with one click.

confirm.confirmedBody: New jobs for “{search}” will be emailed {cadence}. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link.
confirm.unsubscribedBody: This address left these alerts. Sign up again if you want them back.
confirm.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
confirm.invalidBody: Confirmation links work for 72 hours. Sign up again to get a new one.
confirm.unavailable: Job alerts by email are not available here.
confirm.error: We couldn't check this link. Try again.
